card.name: Words linking items used together or near
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "or", "close", "administered" or "within" in phrases about products taken at the same time, close together, or of the same kind. Seen mostly in drug-interaction and co-administration sentences.

modes.label: Closeness to each other
modes.description: Words describing objects being near each other, as in the law of proximity.
modes.example: they perceive objects that are<< close>> to each other as forming a group.

card.writes: It seems to hold back words meaning neighbor or rival, so it cancels a nearness or peer reading in such phrases.
